skills.description_zh: Create, edit, and format Obsidian Flavored Markdown notes with proper wikilinks, embeds, callouts, and heading structure. Uses ### for main titles and sections. Automatically converts title-like lines (emoji-based, short standalone text) to proper headings. When formatting 名言 (famous quotes), applies 一句一行 (one sentence per line) layout. Provides incremental edit strategy guidance for large text restructures. Use when working with .md files in Obsidian vaults, when user mentions wikilinks, callouts, frontmatter, or asks to format/check/optimize markdown notes. Also evaluates main heading content quality (fused from obsidian-title): rewrites poor titles — keyword-only, generic, repeating frontmatter title, or carrying clipping-noise prefixes like date numbers (8.1.20260815) / filler phrases (按年份整理好了) — by summarizing from body content, then syncs frontmatter three-way title fields (title, oldtitle, 标题); only rewrites when quality is poor, never rewrites good titles. For title-only changes use /obsidian-title. Also removes redundant horizontal rules (---) from body text (frontmatter boundaries kept), keeps inline tags and frontmatter tags in sync, and respects dinox/五彩-managed frontmatter fields (sync fields like feishu_url, noteId, 创建时间, oldtitle stay untouched to avoid sync-overwrite loops).
